senses.gloss: डम m. A despised mixed caste.
डमर (I) m. 1. Riot, tumult; 2. terrifying an enemy by shouts and jestures.
डमर (II) n. Running away through fear.
डामर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Terrific, पर्याप्तं मयि रमणीयडामरत्वं संधत्ते गगनतलप्रयाणवेगः M.M.v.; 2. beautiful, variegated (?), (चिकुरे) शिखंडिशिखंडकडामरे Git.G.xii.
डामर (II) m. 1. An affray, a riot; 2. the bustle and confusion of festivity or strife.
डामर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Terrific, पर्याप्तं मयि रमणीयडामरत्वं संधत्ते गगनतलप्रयाणवेगः M.M.v.; 2. beautiful, variegated (?), (चिकुरे) शिखंडिशिखंडकडामरे Git.G.xii.
डमरु m. (according to some n.) A sort of small drum, shaped like an hour-glass usually carried about by Kāpālikas.
